head: Samsung Care Plus ads after a phone drop may come in One UI 9.5
dek: Code in the One UI 9.5 beta suggests Galaxy phones could push Samsung Care Plus offers after a hard fall, according to an app teardown by Android Authority. Samsung hasn't confirmed it, and the feature may never ship.
details: The code sits in Samsung's Warranty Care app (version 1.9.50.23) in One UI 9.5 Beta 1 on a Galaxy S26 Ultra. A fall of 90 centimeters or more onto a hard surface within 24 hours, or three falls of 60 centimeters or more within 30 days, could trigger a notification such as "Protect your phone from falls". The offers would go only to eligible phones not yet enrolled in Care Plus, signed in to a Samsung account, between 9 AM and 8 PM, at most three times per drop rule. Drop logs stay on the phone for 30 days, and Samsung can switch the offers off from its servers.
where: Found in the One UI 9.5 beta on the Galaxy S26 Ultra; not confirmed or released
means: If you own a Galaxy phone without Care Plus, a future update might show you insurance offers after a drop, under the Marketing notifications of Warranty and care. Android Authority notes that Care Plus doesn't cover damage from before you sign up.
todo: Nothing to do yet. If the offers arrive and you don't want them: Settings, Notifications, App notifications, the three-dot menu, Show system apps, then Warranty and care, Notification categories, and turn off Marketing.
thumb_words: SAMSUNG CARE+ ADS AFTER A DROP?
